title: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance…
content: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 to turn an initial image idea into a storyboard and then generate the final video in Seedance.
tips: Use a workflow of Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 to turn an initial image idea into a storyboard and then generate the final video in Seedance.

es.content: Utiliza un flujo de trabajo de Imagen/Concepto → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 para convertir una idea inicial de imagen en un storyboard y luego generar el video final en Seedance.

fr.content: Utilisez un flux de travail Image/Concept → GPT personnalisé → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 pour transformer une idée d'image initiale en storyboard, puis générez la vidéo finale dans Seedance.

ja.content: 最初の画像アイデアをストーリーボードに変換し、最終的なビデオをSeedanceで生成するために、Image/Concept → Custom GPT → Image-to-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0のワークフローを使用します。

ko.content: 이미지/컨셉 → Custom GPT → 이미지-스토리보드 → Seedance 2.0의 워크플로우를 사용하여 초기 이미지 아이디어를 스토리보드로 변환한 후 Seedance에서 최종 비디오를 생성하세요.

pt.content: Use um fluxo de trabalho de Imagem/Conceito → GPT Personalizado → Imagem-para-Storyboard → Seedance 2.0 para transformar uma ideia inicial de imagem em um storyboard e, em seguida, gerar o vídeo final no Seedance.
